Agreed with the Requirement Agent default: rate limiting is the highest-value, lowest-risk interpretation of "more secure" here - it directly blunts the automated-abuse threat model without touching redirect semantics. Alias entropy and redirect allowlisting are reasonable follow-ups but out of scope for this change. Approved.
